cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
  project(LMX_Usage_Examples LANGUAGES C)
endif()
set(LMX_EXAMPLE_COLLECTION_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/..")
set(LMX_EXAMPLE_BINARY_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")
if(NOT TARGET LMX::all)
  add_subdirectory("${LMX_EXAMPLE_COLLECTION_ROOT}" lmx_collection)
endif()
# These small programs use the exact targets supplied by the collection.
# Upstream reference examples have their individual prerequisites in the index.
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/collection/targets.cmake")
enable_testing()
add_subdirectory(checks)
add_subdirectory(archive)

# Each demonstration writes into its own build-directory workspace.
get_property(_example_targets DIRECTORY PROPERTY BUILDSYSTEM_TARGETS)
foreach(_target IN LISTS _example_targets)
  if(_target MATCHES "^lmx_example_")
    string(REGEX REPLACE "^lmx_example_" "" _name "${_target}")
    set(_work "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/demo-output/${_name}")
    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_work}")
    set(_args)
    if(_name STREQUAL "qr_image")
      set(_args "archive-qr.pgm" "C99 humanity archive")
    elseif(_name STREQUAL "xlsx_roundtrip")
      set(_args "archive-table.xlsx")
    endif()
    add_test(NAME "examples.${_name}" COMMAND "${_target}" ${_args})
    set_tests_properties("examples.${_name}" PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY "${_work}" TIMEOUT 45)
  endif()
endforeach()
